$comment: The roster of spec §13f, per field. The nine core roles are a floor: a field may add and may not remove. This field adds one, and it is admitted only because a ladder rung has no core owner.

sub_agents.name: literature
sub_agents.does: finds and reads prior work; produces claims with citations
sub_agents.why_separate: reading and doing must not share a context, or the agent finds what it set out to find

sub_agents.name: twin
sub_agents.does: maintains the cohort-in-time model — enrolment, weighting, follow-up, censoring, competing risks
sub_agents.why_separate: the model a claim is graded against may not be owned by the claim's author, and this twin stops being valid outside the survey's sampling frame — a national survey does not transport to a clinic

sub_agents.name: corpus
sub_agents.does: fetches and validates NHANES + the CDC linked mortality file; refuses when the linkage is absent
sub_agents.why_separate: never substitutes simulated follow-up: survival data is the easiest of all to simulate convincingly, and a benchmark that did it would produce numbers that are not results

sub_agents.name: method
sub_agents.why_separate: the only role that writes the thing being judged

sub_agents.name: runner
sub_agents.does: executes analyses, on leased compute when needed
sub_agents.why_separate: keeps cost and placement out of the method's hands

sub_agents.name: verifier
sub_agents.does: judges a claim against the criterion written before it
sub_agents.why_separate: independence is temporal and authorial (§13i) — and here it refuses any result not reported beside the age-and-sex floor

sub_agents.name: reproducer
sub_agents.does: re-runs a published survival result from its artifacts alone
sub_agents.why_separate: catches the result that only exists on the machine that made it — and in this field, the one whose censoring rule was never written down

sub_agents.name: teacher
sub_agents.does: derives the curriculum from the evidence chain
sub_agents.why_separate: teaching is a product and must be checkable like one; this one refuses to report a hazard ratio without the absolute risk difference beside it

sub_agents.name: writer
sub_agents.does: assembles the field page and the paper
sub_agents.why_separate: writing last, from the record, not from intent

sub_agents.name: floor
sub_agents.does: fits the age-and-sex-only model independently, before any candidate is scored
sub_agents.why_separate: rung 2 is the field's whole question and no core role owns it. Fitted by `method` it would be a floor set by the party that has to clear it — and most published risk scores have never been asked to clear one at all
sub_agents.$owns_comment: rung 3's cycle disjointness is the twin's and the experts'; the floor consumes the split and may not choose it

sub_agents.name: collection-robot
sub_agents.does: draws and processes samples within a consented protocol
sub_agents.why_separate: the only member here whose acts reach the world and cannot be undone, so it carries the §13i envelope: it refuses every act without a grant naming that act, refuses to collect outside consented scope, and reports what it moved rather than what it intended
sub_agents.$owns_comment: owns no rung, and that is the point of listing it. It can make a corpus arrive faster and cannot advance a single rung on its own — see the envelope comment
sub_agents.refusal: refuses any collection without a grant naming the sample and the consent it was taken under; reports what it collected, never what it intended  [drafted by the console session to satisfy the rule that an embodied member states a refusal — confirm or replace]

tools.for: pooling across sites and studies, with heterogeneity reported

tools.tool: cohort clients (NHANES + CDC linked mortality file)
tools.for: clinical, laboratory and questionnaire markers with real follow-up
tools.$comment: access is granted to a person under a data-use agreement, not to an agent. The owner holds the agreement; the agent reads what the owner already has, and refuses rather than applying on anyone's behalf

tools.for: predicted-against-observed, and the estimate's change when competing risks are modelled — rungs 4 and 5
adding to a cohort under a consented protocol — rung 1

$envelope_comment: needs_envelope: a physical act (§13i). One tool here needs one, and the field's central fact is what it still cannot buy — longevity is gated on FOLLOW-UP TIME. A collection robot can draw and process samples faster; it cannot make anyone older, and it cannot shorten a cohort's follow-up by a single day. This is the clearest case in the programme of a field where throughput is not the constraint, and a roster that omitted the body would have hidden the reason.
$revision: brought to the corrected embodiment model (spec §13i): `kind` on every member, and corpus/runner/reproducer un-flagged — embodiment is a kind of member, not a flag, and an embodied `reproducer` puts hands on a JUDGING member. The embodied row is `collection-robot`, which was already here.
